Definition
[pointed $C^{m,\alpha }$ convergence of manifolds]

Source: petersen:page-0427, petersen:page-0428 ↗ def:pet-ch11-tensor-convergence-compact-subset ↗ def:pet-ch11-cmalpha-norm-pointed We say pointed complete Riemannian manifolds converge in the pointed $C^{m,\alpha }$ topology, $(M_i,g_i,p_i)\to (M,g,p)$, if for every $R>0$ there is a domain $\Omega \supset B(p,R)\subset M$ and embeddings $F_i:\Omega \to M_i$ for large $i$ with $F_i(p)=p_i$, $F_i(\Omega )\supset B(p_i,R)$, and $F_i^*g_i\to g$ on $\Omega $ in the $C^{m,\alpha }$ topology.
